ios.desc:
Apollo Weather helps you plan better bike rides with forecasts built for real training needs. Made by a cyclist, it answers the questions that matter most:

1. What are the best days to ride this week?
2. What are the best hours each day?
3. How should you prepare?

Unlike generic weather apps, Apollo takes a cyclist-first approach to help you make better decisions about when, where, and how you ride.

IDEAL CONDITIONS & RATINGS

Apollo doesn’t just display temperature or rain chances. It provides clear, easy-to-understand hourly ratings (PERFECT, ACCEPTABLE, or BAD) tailored to your personalized ideal conditions and active times. There are no hidden formulas; you decide what’s ideal for your rides.

WEATHER GROUPS & ROUTE ANALYSIS

Plan for your actual routes and training sessions. Weather Groups let you track hourly forecasts across multiple locations, helping you choose the right gear, optimal times, and better hydration or fueling strategies.

Add a route via existing Health app workouts, GPX, or FIT files, and visualize forecast conditions along the way. Avoid tough headwinds or heat spikes, so you can focus on enjoying the ride.

Key benefits:

- Select the right gear every time
- Choose the best days and hours to ride
- Stay ahead on hydration and nutrition
- Avoid challenging winds and conditions for a smoother return home

ADDITIONAL FEATURES

Apollo includes a full-featured daily and hourly 10-day forecast for general use, but it truly shines for cyclists planning the week ahead.

Upgrade to Premium to unlock:

- Weather Groups & route analysis
- Apple Watch app with complications
- Home screen and Lock screen widgets
- Customizable ideal conditions and active times

SUPPORT

If you have questions, ideas, or need help, reach out anytime: support@apolloweather.com

PRIVACY

Your privacy is important! Apollo Weather may ask your permission to read workout data from the Health app. Workout data is used to let you add an optional route in Weather Groups. Apollo keeps all your data secure and on your device. Your data is never sold or shared with any other apps, services or networks. 

—

Apollo PREMIUM includes  weather groups with multiple locations, home screen widgets, update ideal conditions and active times.

Apollo ULTRA includes all the features of PREMIUM, plus 20 locations and auto-generate locations in Weather Groups.
